verdict.rationale: Supabase documents Database Webhooks that fire after INSERT, UPDATE and DELETE table events. They are built on triggers via pg_net and deliver HTTP payloads to any endpoint, including Edge Functions, which are documented for listening to webhooks. That clearly covers running functions automatically on database events. Missing for 10: any evidence of triggering functions on auth events (e.g., auth hooks), detail on delivery guarantees or retries, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
